cmd: ok=1; for p in lme4 tidybayes marginaleffects; do i=$(Rscript -e "suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(commandArgs(TRUE)[1], character.only=TRUE)); cat(as.character(packageVersion(commandArgs(TRUE)[1])))" $p); l=$(jq -r .Packages.$p.Version renv.lock | sed s/-/./g); echo $p installed=$i lock=$l; [ -n "$i" ] && [ "$i" = "$l" ] || ok=0; done; for p in brms cmdstanr mgcv; do i=$(Rscript -e "cat(as.character(packageVersion(commandArgs(TRUE)[1])))" $p); l=$(jq -r .Packages.$p.Version renv.lock | sed s/-/./g); echo $p installed=$i lock=$l; [ -n "$i" ] && [ "$i" = "$l" ] || ok=0; done; [ $ok -eq 1 ]
title: Chapter 2 environment additions, lme4 tidybayes marginaleffects in renv
